findsmith-app-title: Find and replace tool for Wikimedia projects
findsmith-home-lead: A browser-based Wikimedia find-and-replace workspace inspired by AutoWikiBrowser.
findsmith-home-development-message: This tool is not ready for production use yet. Review each proposed change carefully before saving it to Wikimedia.
findsmith-home-alpha-message: This is an early test version. Features may be incomplete or change, and errors are likely. Review each proposed change carefully before saving it to Wikimedia.
findsmith-home-beta-message: This is a test version. The main features are complete, but some problems may remain. Review each proposed change carefully before saving it to Wikimedia.
findsmith-home-login-description: Sign in through Wikimedia. FindSmith never sees or stores your password. OAuth tokens are kept in an encrypted sign-in cookie, not in our database.
findsmith-add-wiki-description: Enter the domain of a Wikimedia project. FindSmith checks its protected Project:AutoWikiBrowser/CheckPageJSON and loads its namespaces.
findsmith-project-awb-access-warning: Your Wikimedia account is not in this wiki's Project:AutoWikiBrowser/CheckPageJSON enabledusers or enabledbots list. FindSmith reviews are still available, but saving edits is disabled.
findsmith-project-add-a-source-to-build-: Add a source to build a page list.
findsmith-project-review-shortcuts: Shortcuts: Ctrl+Enter or ⌘+Enter save and next · when no field is focused: P previous · S skip
findsmith-project-i-will-follow-this-wik: I will follow this wiki's editing policies.
findsmith-project-skip-a-match-if-it-ove: Skip a match if it overlaps a selected region.
findsmith-project-name-a-rule-and-save-i: Name a rule and save it here to use it in other projects.
findsmith-project-configuration-changed-: Configuration changed. Apply rules to refresh the current review.
findsmith-project-no-diff-the-proposed-w: No diff — the proposed wikitext matches the current revision.
findsmith-project-no-diff-the-rules-did-: No diff — the rules did not change this page.
findsmith-project-build-a-page-list-to-b: Build a page list to begin review, or enter a page title to test the current rules.
findsmith-project-comparison-count: $1 only in pasted list · $2 only in queue · $3 in both
findsmith-project-preparse-progress: Pre-parsing $1 of $2 {{PLURAL:$2|page|pages}}. Pages without changes are skipped; pages with changes remain for review.
findsmith-project-review-finished: Review complete: $1 saved, $2 skipped. To review again, apply the rules or build a new page list.
findsmith-project-preparse-stale: Preview is out of date. Refresh to see the current proposed text.
findsmith-project-click-refresh-preview: Click Refresh preview to render this page.
findsmith-project-access-error: Could not verify AutoWikiBrowser access for this wiki: $1
findsmith-project-comparison-tooltip: Comparison with the current wiki revision; no wiki edit has been made.
findsmith-project-append-titles-placehol: Append page titles, one per line
findsmith-project-confirm-discard-manual: Discard the manual changes in the proposed wikitext and apply the current project rules?
findsmith-project-save-blocker-not-revie: This page cannot be saved again in this review. Change the rules and apply them to start a fresh review.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-no-change: This page has no proposed changes.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-summary-l: The edit summary must be at most 500 characters, including the Findsmith attribution.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-attributi: The Findsmith attribution is added automatically.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-recompute: The diff is updating after your change to the proposed wikitext.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-policies: Acknowledge this wiki’s editing policies for the new review.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-page-righ: MediaWiki reports that this page is not editable.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-rights-un: Your edit rights could not be verified.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-awb-list: Your account is not on this wiki’s AutoWikiBrowser enabled list.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-awb-check: AutoWikiBrowser access could not be verified.
findsmith-project-confirm-delete-saved-r: Delete saved rule “$1” from your library?
findsmith-api-structural-invalid-title: “$1” is not a valid template or category name on this wiki.
findsmith-api-rule-find-required: Rule $1 must have a find value.
findsmith-api-rule-value-required: Rule $1 must have an operation value.
findsmith-api-rule-category-invalid: Rule $1 has an invalid category name.
findsmith-api-rule-template-invalid: Rule $1 needs a valid template name and parameter name.
findsmith-api-generation-interrupted: Building the page list was interrupted, for example by a server restart. Build the page list again.
findsmith-api-summary-one-line: The edit summary must be one line.
findsmith-api-save-awb-access: This account is not approved in this wiki's Project:AutoWikiBrowser/CheckPageJSON, or access could not be verified.
findsmith-api-save-rights-unverified: Could not verify local Wikimedia edit permissions.
findsmith-api-save-account-blocked: This account is blocked on the selected wiki.
findsmith-api-save-new-messages: Read your new messages on the selected wiki before editing.
findsmith-api-save-rights-missing: This account lacks read or edit rights on the selected wiki.
findsmith-api-save-reload-page: Reload and review this page again: $1
findsmith-api-save-revision-changed: The page revision changed. Reload and review the latest revision before saving.
findsmith-api-save-page-protected: This page is not editable by the current account.
findsmith-api-save-bot-excluded: This page excludes automated edits with {{bots}} or {{nobots}}.
findsmith-api-save-bot-check-failed: Could not verify this page's bot-exclusion templates.
findsmith-api-save-outcome-ambiguous: The edit outcome is unknown. Check the wiki page and start a new review; this job cannot retry it.
findsmith-api-save-conflict: Edit conflict. Reload and review the current revision before trying again.
findsmith-api-save-abuse-filter: The wiki's abuse filter warned or blocked this edit. Review it on the wiki; FindSmith will not confirm it automatically.
findsmith-api-save-rejected: MediaWiki rejected the edit ($1). Review the page before resuming.
findsmith-api-page-model-unsupported: The page uses unsupported content model “$1”.
findsmith-api-add-at-least-one-page-sour: Add at least one page source.
findsmith-api-check-the-wiki-page-and-bu: Check the wiki page and build a new list before changing rules after an uncertain or policy-sensitive edit.
findsmith-api-choose-a-different-name-fo: Choose a different name for this project.
findsmith-api-enter-a-wikimedia-wiki-dom: Enter a Wikimedia wiki domain, such as en.wikipedia.org.
findsmith-api-only-wikimedia-project-dom: Only Wikimedia project domains are supported.
findsmith-api-project-name-must-contain-: Project name must contain between 1 and 255 characters.
findsmith-api-project-autowikibrowser-ch: Project:AutoWikiBrowser/CheckPageJSON does not exist on this wiki.
findsmith-api-reload-the-page-and-try-ag: Reload the page and try again. No changes were made.
findsmith-api-reload-the-project-to-get-: Reload the project to get the latest version, then apply your changes again.
findsmith-api-reload-the-review-to-get-t: Reload the review to get the latest progress, then try again.
findsmith-api-rule-name-must-contain-bet: Rule name must contain between 1 and 255 characters.
findsmith-api-rules-changed-review-every: Rules changed. Review every page again against its latest revision.
findsmith-api-saved-rule-unavailable: This saved rule does not exist or you do not have access to it.
findsmith-api-select-namespaces-availabl: Select namespaces available on this wiki.
findsmith-api-stop-pre-parse-before-chan: Stop pre-parse before changing the queue.
findsmith-api-the-requested-page-does-no: The requested page does not exist.
findsmith-api-this-job-encountered-a-wik: This job encountered a wiki policy warning. Start a new review after resolving it on the wiki.
findsmith-api-this-job-is-paused-after-a: This job is paused after an edit attempt. Start a new review after checking the wiki page.
findsmith-api-this-project-does-not-exis: This project does not exist or you do not have access to it.
findsmith-api-this-review-does-not-exist: This review does not exist or you do not have access to it.
findsmith-api-this-wiki-is-already-in-th: This wiki is already in the list.
findsmith-api-wait-for-list-generation-o: Wait for list generation or stop pre-parse before changing the rules.
findsmith-api-access-rights-unverified: Could not verify your edit rights on this wiki. Reload the review to try again.
findsmith-api-account-blocked: Your account is blocked on this wiki.
findsmith-api-new-messages: Read your new messages on this wiki before editing.
findsmith-api-edit-rights-missing: Your account lacks read or edit rights on this wiki.
findsmith-api-edit-outcome-unknown-reaso: Edit outcome unknown until Wikimedia responds; do not retry this job if the request is interrupted.
findsmith-api-wiki-connect-error: Could not connect to this wiki: $1
findsmith-api-queue-limit-range: Queue limit must be between 1 and $1.
findsmith-api-skip-in-use: The page has an “in use” or “under construction” template.
findsmith-api-skip-namespace: The page is outside the selected namespaces.
findsmith-api-skip-bot-exclusion: The page excludes your account with {{bots}} or {{nobots}}.
findsmith-api-skip-contains: The page contains the text set in the skip options.
findsmith-api-skip-not-contains: The page does not contain the text set in the skip options.
findsmith-api-skip-no-change: The rules make no changes to this page.
findsmith-api-skip-too-few-replacements: The rules make fewer replacements than the skip options allow.
findsmith-api-skip-too-many-replacements: The rules make more replacements than the skip options allow.
findsmith-api-skip-replacement-bounds: The minimum number of replacements cannot be greater than the maximum.
findsmith-api-skip-pattern-too-long: A skip condition is too long.
findsmith-api-skip-pattern-invalid: A skip condition is not a valid regular expression: $1
findsmith-api-start-account-blocked: Your account is blocked on this wiki, so a new review cannot start.
findsmith-api-start-rights-missing: Your account cannot read or edit on this wiki, or FindSmith was not granted permission to edit. A new review cannot start.
findsmith-api-start-rights-unverified: Your account permissions on this wiki could not be checked. Try again in a moment.
findsmith-api-save-too-fast: Wait {{PLURAL:$1|$1 second|$1 seconds}} before saving the next edit.
findsmith-api-save-repeated-failures: Several saves in a row failed, so editing is paused. Check the wiki, then build a new page list.
findsmith-api-edit-verified-not-saved: The page history shows the edit was not saved. Resume the review to try again.
findsmith-api-edit-still-in-progress-det: The save request may still reach the wiki. Check again in {{PLURAL:$1|$1 second|$1 seconds}}.
findsmith-api-edit-outcome-unconfirmed-d: The page history does not show whether this exact edit was saved. Check the page history on the wiki, then start a new review.
findsmith-project-skip-no-change: When the rules make no changes
findsmith-project-skip-in-use: Pages with an “in use” or “under construction” template
findsmith-project-skip-not-contains: Skip if the page does not contain
findsmith-project-skip-regex: Treat these texts as regular expressions
findsmith-project-skip-case-sensitive: Match letter case in these texts
findsmith-project-skip-min-replacements: Skip if replacements are fewer than
findsmith-project-skip-max-replacements: Skip if replacements are more than
findsmith-project-skip-bot-exclusion-not: Pages whose {{bots}} or {{nobots}} templates exclude your account are always skipped.
findsmith-project-edit-in-flight-notice: The last save was interrupted, so it is not known whether it reached the wiki. Check the page history before continuing.
findsmith-project-verify-edit: Check whether the edit was saved
